      Nike Book 2 “Detroit Lions” Releases September 4th

      Nike

      Published on

      Aug 25, 2026
      By Mario Briguglio
      Listen to audio version of this article
      Sponsored by
      0:00 / 1:19
      Instaread

      Detroit continues to show up in Devin Booker’s signature line, and the latest Nike Book 2 might be the strongest hometown connection yet.

      - Advertisement -

      The upcoming Nike Book 2 “Detroit Lions” follows several Detroit-inspired pairs tied to Booker, including the Chevy-themed release, “Iron Fist,” and “Tigers” colorways. This time, Nike Basketball turns directly to the city’s NFL team for inspiration.

      The shoe comes dressed in the Lions’ familiar Honolulu Blue, with metallic silver and grey details worked across the upper, tongue, and heel. The color combination closely follows Detroit’s uniforms without overdoing the theme.

      Nike also brings Lions branding into the design, making this more than just a team-colored sneaker. Booker previously wore a Detroit Lions-inspired Book 1 PE, but that pair never received a public release.

      Another Detroit detail appears inside the shoe, where the insoles feature a map of the city. It continues a theme Nike has used on other Book 2 releases connected to Booker’s hometown.

      Nike Book 2 Detroit Lions Release Date

      The Nike Book 2 “Detroit Lions” releases September 4, 2026 in men’s sizing for $155 through Nike.com, Foot Locker, and select retailers.

      Stay up to date with all upcoming sneaker releases from our Sneaker Release Dates page.

      Nike Book 2 “Detroit Lions”
      Color: Photo Blue/White-Metallic Silver
      Style Code: IM4667-401
      Release Date: September 4, 2026
      Price: $155
